Padre

Lieutenant · Fixer · Heywood

A former priest who became Santo Domingo's fixer. Only gives work to those who leave kids and the elderly alone. Meetings in the back room of a diner.

Tactics: Doesn't fight: when threatened he leaves through the back door while his guards (2 boosters) cover him.

HP 45 · Seriously Wounded 23 · Death Save 6

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
